title: Breakdown and Settings close buttons have no accessible name
detail: Both render `<button className="back" onClick={...}>{Ic.x}</button>` — Ic.x (line 603) is a bare `<svg>` with no `<title>` and no text content. Every other close button using the same Ic.x glyph in this file sets `aria-label="Close"` (lines 2059, 3822, 3850, 4170, 4419, 4493, 5305, 5687) or an equivalent specific label — these two are the only ones that don't.
failure: A screen reader user opening 'Your paycheck math' (Breakdown) or Settings (where the savings-goal lines live) tabs to the dismiss button and hears only 'button' with no name, so they can't tell it's the close control without trial-and-error activation.
fix: Add aria-label="Close" to both buttons, matching every sibling close button in the file.
